response_eligibility.accepted_session_per_slot: the complete session with the earliest final-vote timestamp; if complete sessions tie on final-vote timestamp, the lexicographically smallest session_id wins; every other session for that slot (partial or complete, earlier or later) is excluded and recorded
response_eligibility.all_exclusions_outcome_blind: every eligibility decision above uses only identifiers, timestamps, schedule consistency and completeness, never the choice made
response_eligibility.complete_session: a valid session containing exactly one vote for each of its slot's 24 challenges
response_eligibility.maturity: analysis opens only when all 40 slots have exactly one accepted session (960 rows); no early opening
response_eligibility.replacement: a replacement voter receives the identical slot URL and a new session_id; no challenge moves between slots
response_eligibility.row_validity: a row is valid only if its challenge_id belongs to its slot schedule, canonical_left equals the frozen schedule display_left for that slot/challenge, display_order equals the frozen position, clicked_display_L_or_R is consistent with canonical_choice and canonical_left, and utc_iso8601_timestamp is a parseable UTC timestamp
response_eligibility.session_validity: a session is invalid if any row is invalid, if it contains rows for more than one slot, or if any challenge is voted more than once within the session
response_eligibility.voter_eligibility: one person per slot; people who have seen V9 research artifacts, model verdicts or this study design (including the project owner and reviewers) are ineligible
response_eligibility.voter_instruction: judge each trade on your own dynasty valuation without consulting any trade calculator or value chart

session_id_rule: random >=128-bit identifier generated client-side when a slot session starts; never reused across sessions or slots
timestamp_rule: utc_iso8601_timestamp is recorded for every vote row and must parse as UTC; session final-vote timestamp is the maximum valid row timestamp; exact ties are resolved by lexicographic session_id as frozen in response_eligibility
